facts.fact: The 2025-2029 strategic plan for modernising civil registration and vital statistics is costed at 101.683 billion FCFA, with 63% for axis 3 (computerisation and interoperability) and 60,425 million FCFA for fully computerising the system; the plan carries no date, so the publisher's year label is used.

The plan's technical lead is the Bureau National de l'État Civil (BUNEC) under the supervision of the decentralisation ministry MINDDEVEL, whose minister signs the preface; undated, so the publisher's year label is used.

The plan's baseline states that manual registration and weak interconnection of civil registration systems make systematic, reliable and exhaustive vital statistics impossible; undated, so the publisher's year label is used.
